profile.headline: Software Engineer at Meta (Threads Ads) | Android & React Native | 20+ years building mobile
profile.summary:
I've been building mobile software for over 20 years — from 3G video calling on Samsung smartphones, to Java ME platforms at Sun and Oracle, to React Native and now ads engineering for Threads at Meta.

I recently joined Meta's Threads Ads Engineering team, after working in the Applied AI org on Meta AI. Before that, I spent over two years on the React Native team, serving both the open-source community and Meta's internal apps. I helped feature teams across the company adopt React Native, fixed and improved the framework itself, and led the Android 15/16 migration for React Native.

Before Meta, I built consumer features used by millions. 
• At Nextdoor, I rewrote key parts of the comment composer to improve @mention support and fix performance issues. I also migrated legacy web-view screens for small business features to native Jetpack Compose.
• At Venmo, I worked on a major update to the Android experimentation framework, adding near-real-time feature flag updates, and helped drive modularization and target SDK upgrades.

What I bring:
• Depth across the whole stack, from low-level system features on reference hardware to polished consumer UI
• A habit of taking on unfamiliar problems: I've shipped CarPlay/Android Auto integrations, voice prototypes, and VR demos when the work called for it
• Strong cross-functional communication with product, design, data, partners, and customers, across companies and regions (fluent in English and Korean)

Core tools: Kotlin, Java, React Native, Jetpack Compose, GraphQL, Android platform/SDK migrations, and modular app architecture

positions.description: • Contributing to making Meta AI better

positions.title: Software Engineer, React Native
positions.description:
• enabling React Native features for various features teams within Meta
• enhancing and bug fixing React Native Core for open source and Meta internal
• leading Android 15/16 migration efforts for React Native

positions.title: Android Engineer
positions.description:
• Rewrote key parts of the comment composer to improve @mention support and resolve performance issues
• Built native features for the annual Neighborhood Faves survey, replacing the previous web-view-based surveys
• Developed features supporting small businesses on the Android app, including migrating legacy web-view screens to native Jetpack Compose/Kotlin
• Contributed small backend changes, including GraphQL resolvers in Python
positions.insights: Skills: Kotlin · Jetpack Compose · Java · Android Studio · Python · GraphQL

positions.title: Android Engineer
positions.description:
• Major contributor to Venmo's internal Android experimentation API (feature flags and A/B tests); shipped a major update that simplified development and added near-real-time updates
• Partnered with product and data science on experimentation, and helped engineers troubleshoot integration issues
• Implemented friends list privacy settings
• Contributed to Android modularization efforts
• Coordinated with stakeholders on Android target SDK updates
• Diagnosed and fixed bugs across the app
positions.insights: Skills: Kotlin · Java · Model-View-Presenter (MVP) · Android Studio

positions.title: Lead/ Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Tech lead for a voice proof of concept on an Android tablet, partnering with LG's AI team to integrate their voice engine with the Gracenote Global Music API
• Developed CarPlay and Android Auto clients and integrations on an Android-based automotive reference board, used to demonstrate and sell a major automotive product
• Built Android apps showcasing the full capabilities of Gracenote products, using RESTful backends and native SDKs
• Worked on a small team using agile practices and design thinking to solve problems, prototype new products, and demonstrate existing features
• Also built a VR prototype for Google Daydream (Unity/C#) and a web dashboard (React/Redux)
• Tools: Dagger, Retrofit/OkHttp, RxJava, JUnit, Robolectric, Mockito, Espresso, Cucumber

positions.title: Senior Applications Engineer
positions.description:
• Helped customers build software and businesses on Gracenote products, including Android, iOS, and embedded SDKs, web APIs, and XML-delivered metadata
• Led technical and design discussions with customers to speed adoption and ensure best practices during implementation
• Partnered with sales, product management, engineering, and content teams to close technical gaps and adapt Gracenote products to market needs
• Supported sales as a technical advocate for Gracenote products, helping drive revenue
• Wrote Python scripts to analyze large XML files and triage customer issues
• Won 1st place at the 2014 Gracenote Hackathon with an Android tablet app combining Gracenote's Rhythm (personalized radio) API and the YouTube Player API

positions.title: Senior Software Developer, Java Engineering Services
positions.description:
(Sun Microsystems was acquired by Oracle)
• Tech lead for delivering Java ME as a major application development platform for Qualcomm's M2M chipset
• Designed and implemented parts of the new device access APIs for Java ME Embedded 3.2
• Helped draft the new device access API specification for Java ME
• Worked with product management and engineering to enhance Java ME to meet customer needs
• Speaker, Oracle M2M Technology Solutions Seminar (Seoul, May 2013)
• Built mobile app demos for proof-of-concept projects: a hybrid app (HTML, CSS, JavaScript with jQuery Mobile and Knockout.js) and a GWT app (GWTMobile)
• Partially ported the Linux version of Java ME (CDC) native class libraries to Mac OS X (Darwin)

positions.title: Software Engineer - Java Engineering Services
positions.description:
• Mainly worked on commercializing and demoing Oracle JavaME and JavaFX Mobile products on various mobile platforms (BREW, LiMo, Windows Mobile and etc.)
• Conducted debugging, fixed bugs and wrote new code on top of huge legacy code base
• Received very positive feedback from major OEM and operator on PoC projects and demos done with JavaFX TV & Mobile
• Expertise in commercializing JavaME Bluetooth and Location technologies
• Exercised effective technical communication with OEM companies and also with multi-regional teams within Sun

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Tech lead for the 3G video-telephony application, designing the overall architecture and integrating the protocol and audio/video codec layers
• Built multimedia applications, including 3G video-telephony and DMB (mobile TV), for best-selling Windows Mobile phones in Korea used by hundreds of thousands of people
• Created core features for first-version applications that were later reused and extended across many projects
• Debugged and performance-tuned complex multi-threaded multimedia and communications applications
• Founding member of a new team, playing a key role in developing and growing it
• Delivered through eight of Samsung's intensive product development cycles
